hardware.compute: TBD — Raspberry Pi or similar SBC per location
hardware.display: TBD — large-format capacitive touch display (~27"), wall-mounted landscape
hardware.notes: Hardware not yet purchased. App runs in Chromium kiosk mode pointed at Vercel URL. Pi is just a display client — all state in Supabase cloud.

features.name: Data Layer / Backend
features.notes: App owns all data — no external calendar API. Supabase (PostgreSQL) is the source of truth. Realtime subscriptions push changes instantly to all connected clients. No polling.

features.name: Authentication
features.notes: Supabase Auth with @supabase/ssr. Phase 1: single shared family login. Phase 2: per-user accounts planned.

features.name: Calendar Views
features.notes: Three view types: HourlyGrid (Day/3-Day/Week with time-positioned event blocks), SummaryGrid (2-Week/Month with day boxes and multi-day spanning bars), Schedule (chronological agenda list). All ship in Phase 1.

features.name: Event CRUD
features.notes: Full create/edit/delete via modals. Events support: title, description, location, timed or all-day, multi-member assignment, house tag for Household events.

features.name: Per-Member Filtering
features.notes: Filter chips with dual click zones: avatar = solo mode (show only this person), body = toggle. Compact 4-column grid on mobile, full chip row on desktop.

features.name: Parenting / Custody Schedule
features.notes: 7 or 14-day repeating pattern with per-day toggle in settings. One-off overrides supported. Custody overlay renders as background color on both HourlyGrid and SummaryGrid views.

features.name: Weather Widget
features.notes: Open-Meteo (free, no API key). 16-day daily forecast shown in day headers. Clicking opens hourly detail modal with precip probability. Lat/lon configured in Settings.

features.name: Responsive Mobile Layout
features.notes: Bottom nav on mobile, left sidebar on desktop. Compact filter chips, color-only event tiles in summary views. Tested on iPhone via Tailscale + iPad.

features.name: PWA / Installable
features.notes: PWA manifest, generated icons (192/512px), Apple touch icon. Installable on phones from Vercel URL.

features.name: Per-User Logins
features.notes: Phase 2 start. Each parent gets their own Supabase Auth account. Role stored in user metadata. Household event filtering (kyle/mel/both) depends on this.

features.name: Recurring Events
features.notes: Phase 2. App-native repeat logic (no rrule dependency until external calendars added in Phase 3).
